flows:
Navigate to https://www.metacritic.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
First assert the Most Popular control in the homepage Games carousel is in the sequential keyboard focus order.
Use Tab and Enter to select Most Popular and verify it becomes the selected Games carousel category.
